description: 白象插中路，强迫兵吃后打开h路发动杀攻
explanation_en: White's bishop interposes to cut the coordination between the queen and knight. The forced pawn capture opens the h-file, allowing White's rook to join the attack.

intro.popup: 💡 拦截：白象在b3，黑后c6和黑马e5都守着。象插入d5，能切断黑方协防，强迫对方让路发动攻击吗？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Interference: White's bishop is on b3; Black's queen on c6 and knight on e5 support the defense. Can the bishop interpose on d5 to break their coordination and open an attack?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Bd5！象插d5威胁e6，黑方exd5被迫让路——Rh3随后发动h路杀攻！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Bd5 threatens e6 and cuts the defenders' coordination. The forced exd5 opens the h-file for Rh3 and a mating attack.

moves.popup: 白象Bd5！插入d5，攻击e6兵，同时切断Qc6与Ne5的协防——黑方必须应对！
moves.popup_en: White interposes with Bd5, attacking the pawn on e6 and cutting the coordination between Black's queen on c6 and knight on e5. Black must respond.

moves.popup: 黑兵exd5——被迫吃象，e6→d5，h路攻击线被打开！
moves.popup_en: Black is forced to capture with exd5. The pawn leaves e6, opening the h-file for White's attack.

moves.popup: 白车Rh3！拦截打开通路，车立即占据h3——Qh6+Rh3的杀攻组合威力无穷！
moves.popup_en: White plays Rh3, using the opened line to bring the rook into the attack. The queen-and-rook mating threats are powerful.
